name: openmcp
description: openMCP: audit + cross-post tool for MCP servers. Scores an MCP server repo 0-100 for listing-readiness and cross-posts it to Smithery, the MCP Registry, Docker MCP Catalog, Glama, MCPize, and PulseMCP -- the discovery layer for the MEOK EU AI Act / DORA / NIS2 / CRA compliance fleet.
